# Professionals imagery source package

The original approved source archive is retained outside Git because it is about 196 MB and exceeds GitHub's standard single file limit.

Six web ready reference images used by the Brand Guidelines and Concept Studio are included in `src/assets/imagery-guidelines` with their original filenames.

The complete source archive remains available in the local Professionals Studio workspace as `Professionals-imagery-source-2026-09-04.zip`.
